name: WasteCo Group Limited
summary: WasteCo Group Limited operates throughout New Zealand, providing a full spectrum of waste management, recycling, industrial cleaning, and environmental services. The company's diverse offerings include various waste collection and disposal solutions like skips, wheelie bins, front load and hook bins, along with cardboard baling and landfill operations. They also furnish specialized cleaning services such as septic tank maintenance, portable toilet rentals, road sweeping, and advanced dust-free sweeping and scrubbing techniques. These provisions serve residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal clients. Additionally, WasteCo extends its expertise to safety management training. Founded in 2010, the firm's headquarters are situated in Christchurch, New Zealand.
